title: Vehicle-Amendment Rate Table — Cardinal Financial Responsibility Filing
content:
The vehicle-amendment rate for a vehicle amendment on a Cardinal Financial Responsibility Filing certificate follows the number of amendments the filing's record shows within the past 12 months.

| Amendments on the filing's record within the past 12 months | Vehicle-amendment rate |
|---|---|
| None | 10.00 |
| Exactly one | 15.00 |
| Two or more | 20.00 |

**What counts.** Every amendment entry on the filing's record counts, whatever its reason — vehicle change, address change, policy number change or name change.

**Window.** A window of a number of months covers the entries dated less than that many whole months before today, whole months being counted from the entry's date to today. The 12-month window therefore takes in an amendment entered 11 whole months ago and leaves out one entered 12 whole months ago.

## Table notes (hypothetical histories, today 1 October 2026)

| Amendment entries on the filing's record | Count in window | Rate |
|---|---|---|
| None ever | 0 | 10.00 |
| Address change entered 2 October 2025 | 1 | 15.00 |
| Address change entered 1 October 2025 | 0 (12 whole months) | 10.00 |
| Name change entered 3 March 2026; policy number change entered 9 September 2026 | 2 | 20.00 |
